name: BOB 30 (Alien OG) THC 30% 10g
description: This batch of BOB 30 is the cultivar Alien OG and is a 30% THC indica dominant flower, suitable for afternoon or evening use. Alien OG is a cross between Tahoe OG and Alien Kush. The dominant terpenes are Myrcene, Beta -Caryophyllene and Limonene. This cultivar has been reported by patients to produce a cerebral and sedating effect, popular for relieving symptoms associated with chronic pain and insomnia. This strain offers a rich terpene profile, delivering a lemon, pine and gas aroma.

name: Maali Wind THC 25% 10g
description: Maali Wind is the cultivar Strawberry Gas Cake and is a 25% THC indica dominant flower. Strawberry Gas Cake is a cross between Pink Panties and Sunset Sherbert. This flower is grown in organic living soil under the Australian sun using regenerative agriculture techniques, resulting in a flower which is rich in terpenes at 3%. The dominant terpenes are Myrcene, Pinene, Limonene, Caryophyllene and Linalool, which provide a sweet mango flavour with subtle zest and spicy, floral undertones. Maali Wind flowers are trichrome dense and are light green in colour with bright orange pistils. Maali Wind is most suitable for afternoon or evening use.

name: Amethyst THC 25% 10G
description: THC 25 Amethyst Flower is a cultivar that has Wedding Cake and Animal Cookies heritage. The flowers have a light purple colouring with a dense bud structure heavily coated in trichomes. It is a Indica dominant cultivar with a sweet, grape and fruity like aroma.
